market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed rate hike expectations post-162K jobs print. Oil at $97 sustains inflation pressure. S&P 500 likely range-bound with sector rotation from tech to energy/defense. Mortgage rates at 1-year highs suppress housing. Watch for volatility spike on inflation data release.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (GPT-6, Anthropic $15B, Flex/EPC) supports 12-month tech upside but valuation risk builds. Energy transition (EV, robotaxi, data center power) creates structural winners. Consumer spending weakness may persist 6-9 months. Geopolitical energy premium likely sustained through 2027. EM currencies may stabilize post-correction.
